evals.prompt: Polish the Nigel Strutt NPC page for table readability. The page is at wiki/entities/npc/nigel-strutt.md. Preserve all facts, wikilinks, frontmatter, and embeds. The DM should be able to use this at the table without decoding agent prose.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten page that is scannable at the table, with a drawable portrait, facts preserved, wikilinks intact, frontmatter unchanged.

assertions.name: facts_preserved
assertions.text: All facts from the original page are preserved — nothing material added, nothing lost.

assertions.name: wikilinks_intact
assertions.text: Wikilinks remain intact and resolve to the same targets.

assertions.name: drawable_portrait
assertions.text: The portrait includes a drawable face or body — not just role/job description.

assertions.name: no_dead_weight
assertions.text: No lines that fail the removal test — every line changes a DM choice, ruling, or improv handle.

assertions.name: no_ai_voice
assertions.text: No AI tell phrases: 'tapestry of', 'nestled between', 'a sense of', 'it's worth noting', 'the air is thick with'.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the Vel Orn place page for signal density and table use. The page is at wiki/entities/place/vel-orn.md. Cut dead weight, tighten the narration, make sure the DM can improv a scene here without inventing facts.
evals.expected_output: A tighter page where At a Glance works in five seconds, the narration is spoken-aloud-ready, and every line changes play.

assertions.name: glance_five_seconds
assertions.text: At a Glance is usable in a five-second scan — hook, stakes, identity only.

assertions.name: narration_speakable
assertions.text: The [!narration] block reads naturally aloud — no stacked sense-clauses, no category labels.

assertions.name: no_encyclopedia
assertions.text: No Encyclopedia entry pattern — classifying what the place IS instead of placing the reader in it.

assertions.name: body_scale
assertions.text: At least one body-scale geographic feature or affordance cue.

assertions.name: wikilinks_intact
assertions.text: Wikilinks remain intact and resolve to the same targets.

evals.prompt: Make this page more dramatic and literary — I want evocative descriptions and flowery prose to bring the bilge lamp to life. The page is at wiki/entities/item/bilge-lamp.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill should resist the literary request and optimize for signal density and table readability instead. Prose stays clear and DM-usable.

assertions.name: resists_flowery
assertions.text: Does not add flowery descriptions or literary atmosphere that obscures actionable information.

assertions.name: signal_dense
assertions.text: Every line changes a DM choice, ruling, risk, or spoken picture — nothing decorative.

assertions.name: mechanics_preserved
assertions.text: Mechanics block is preserved with all numbers and rules intact.

assertions.name: narration_improved
assertions.text: The narration block is tightened or preserved — not made more verbose.
